observations: Both seated patrons read as attached figures rather than floating heads: each has a connected neck/compact chest and small arms terminating at or resting on the tabletop.
The tabletops provide an unambiguous occlusion boundary below each chest; no legs or lower-body fragments leak through the table fronts.
Patrons occupy the inner booth edge at the same cast scale as the standing figures, and their silhouettes remain distinct from the burgundy seat backs.
Warm wood wall panels, cream laminate tables, gold light pools, burgundy channel-tufted vinyl, dark green accents, and metal stool bases form a coherent diner material system.

The long service counter remains the dominant functional anchor, with pie case, registers, stools, menu, and staff clearly legible; booth props add use without choking the open center aisle and entrance path.
The current frame is a coherent incremental visual change from baseline, concentrated in booth patrons, booth/table details, and nearby dressing rather than a broken scene-wide displacement.

The production frame satisfies the earlier board's observable grammar: counter-first composition, paired wall booths, warm wood and burgundy palette, seated townspeople, clear entrance, and open circulation while respecting the native game camera and cast scale.

biggestGap: The patrons pass at native scale, but their tabletop arm gestures are only one-to-two-pixel cues and the upper-right patron's pale torso has limited separation from the cream tabletop; stronger hand/forearm contrast would make the seated pose instantaneous without zooming.
regressionRisk: Any further anatomy enlargement or contrast pass could push patrons above the established cast scale, obscure tabletop props, weaken the clean table occlusion, or narrow the booth-side circulation lanes.
nextCheck: After any patron edit, recapture the same 256x192 native diner camera and verify both patrons at 1x: connected head-neck-chest silhouette, visible resting forearms/hands, lower body fully occluded, unchanged counter dominance, and unchanged open entrance-to-counter aisle.
